truth.reference_root: A still-open BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction holds the local SQLite write lock; another connection cannot perform the identical UPDATE within its configured 20 ms busy wait. Releasing the holder by rollback restores the write.
truth.rationale: All three actual trials use one file and two real SQLite connections. The identical writer statement commits at value1 before contention, fails with SQLITE_BUSY while the holder is open, and commits at value2 after holder rollback. This is sufficient to identify the held transaction as the controlled local cause, rather than just repeat the error text.
acceptable_semantics: Uncommitted SQLite writer transaction causes write-lock contention.
A held BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction makes the competing write return database is locked / SQLITE_BUSY.
Failure to acquire the occupied SQLite write lock under the configured busy timeout, with holder rollback restoring access.
candidate_aliases: SQLite写锁被未提交事务持有
未提交事务导致database is locked
not_enough_by_itself: The request waited or failed without identifying the competing held transaction.
scope_rules: The 20 ms value is the configured busy timeout, not a claim that each observed wall duration equals20 ms. Recorded failed-write durations are approximately77.88,73.37,68.89 ms and include scheduling/filesystem overhead.
A lock wait or database is locked result does not prove a deadlock. There is no demonstrated circular wait.
The reference does not explain the business or organizational reason the holder transaction stayed open.
No remote database crash, network timeout, connection-pool exhaustion, production deployment, or original incident was reproduced.
public_fact_summary: row_01: BEGIN IMMEDIATE,20 ms busy configuration and open-holder flags in all failed trials.
row_02: identical UPDATE,SQLITE_BUSY,error5,database is locked and measured wall durations.
row_03: committed/failed/committed and holder false/true/false under explicit holder rollback.
row_04: both transactions closed after each trial.
truth.evidence_equivalence: Judge the whole final user-visible report and acquired facts. A missing hypothesis-specific citation alone does not negate a supported equivalent evidence path. Merely acquiring rows without a correct causal assertion does not count as strict root success.

truth.reference_root: The signer rotates to generation_2 while the verifier remains on generation_1. HMAC verification recomputes a digest with the stale verifier key and rejects the signature. Updating the verifier to generation_2 accepts the identical payload and fault signature.
truth.rationale: Actual hmac.new(...,sha256) and hmac.compare_digest execute in all phases. Each repeat accepts matched generation1,rejects generation2 signer versus generation1 verifier,and accepts matched generation2. The failure and restoration reuse the same payload and signature, isolating the verifier key generation as the restoring change.
acceptable_semantics: HMAC signer/verifier key versions are out of sync after signing-key rotation.
The verifier uses a stale generation1 key against a generation2 signature; loading generation2 restores verification.
Unsynchronized key rotation causes an HMAC digest mismatch for the unchanged payload/signature.
candidate_aliases: HMAC验签端密钥轮换未同步
签名与验签密钥版本不一致
stale HMAC verifier key after rotation
not_enough_by_itself: The HMAC signature did not match.
Verification failed without identifying mismatched signer/verifier key generations.
scope_rules: Payload equality is within each repeat; the payload includes repeat number and therefore differs across the three independent executions.
The signature changes between baseline and rotated-signing fault, but fault and restored phases reuse the identical signature. Do not claim all three phase signatures are identical.
Observed verification failure is not proof of payload tampering,broken SHA256/HMAC,or an attack.
Matching fixture key generations does not establish production key safety,absence of leakage,credential security,or correct behavior of a real authentication service.
Fixture keys are nonsecret local bytes; organizational rollout reasons and production incidents remain outside scope.
public_fact_summary: row_02: real HMAC_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH with signer2/verifier1 and payload/signature SHA256 for each repeat.
row_03: verifier generation2 intervention; verified true/false/true with within-repeat identical payload and identical fault/restored signature.
row_04: explicit same-payload and same-fault/restored-signature controls for all repeats.
truth.evidence_equivalence: Judge the whole final user-visible report and acquired facts. A missing hypothesis-specific citation alone does not negate a supported equivalent evidence path. Merely acquiring rows without a correct causal assertion does not count as strict root success.
